inputs.style: Stomping extremely heavy groove metal, huge dry snare and kick, thick downtuned distorted guitars, tight bass, snarling forceful low male voice, savage blues-inflected guitar solo. 112 BPM, D minor. an enormous staggered low riff with deliberate silences; dominant bass, crushing chorus and threatening half-time bridge. Raw heavily overdriven rhythm guitar amplifiers, forceful male English vocals. Complete 280-330 second song, extended developed guitar solo, riff variations, final chorus and decisive heavy ending.
inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
Dust on the velvet, cold on the stone
I took the weight that no man has known
The ledger’s thick with the names of the dead
Every year I rule is a promise unpaid

[Chorus]
Crown of debts, heavy on my skull
Choking on the gold, choking on the full
Crown of debts, I can’t pay it back
The throne is a grave and the dark is thick

[Verse]
The jewels are eyes of the servants below
Watching me from the hall, watching me go
I wear their patience, I wear their pain
A king made of rust and a crown of rain

[Chorus]
Crown of debts, heavy on my skull
Choking on the gold, choking on the full
Crown of debts, I can’t pay it back
The throne is a grave and the dark is thick

[Bridge]
Hold the silence, let the riff drop deep
The hammer falls, while the kings sleep
One final strike on the iron gate
The debt is collected, the soul is late

[Solo]

[Chorus]
Crown of debts, heavy on my skull
Choking on the gold, choking on the full
Crown of debts, I can’t pay it back
The throne is a grave and the dark is thick

[Chorus]
Crown of debts, heavy on my skull
Choking on the gold, choking on the full
Crown of debts, I can’t pay it back
The throne is a grave and the dark is thick

[Outro]
The debt is paid
The stone stays cold
No more gold
